name: 74006 · Bartlesville, OK
findings: ZIP 74006 (Bartlesville) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74006 (Bartlesville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 74006 (Bartlesville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
